title: Relationship between Zeros & Coefficients

story.text: There is a beautiful and direct relationship between the zeros of a polynomial and its coefficients. This relationship helps us find zeros without factorizing and even form polynomials from given zeros!

explanation.content: If α and β are the zeros of quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c (where a ≠ 0), then:
Sum of zeros: α + β = -b/a
Product of zeros: αβ = c/a
These formulas directly connect zeros to coefficients!
💡 Yaad rakho: Sum = -b/a, Product = c/a
Quadratic: Sum and Product of Zeros:
α + β = -b/a    and    αβ = c/a
Where α and β are zeros of ax² + bx + c = 0

Example: For x² - 5x + 6 = 0
a = 1, b = -5, c = 6
α + β = -(-5)/1 = 5
αβ = 6/1 = 6
Zeros: 2 and 3 (since 2+3=5 and 2×3=6)
If α and β are given zeros, the quadratic polynomial can be written as:
p(x) = x² - (α + β)x + αβ
Yaani: x² - (Sum of zeros)x + (Product of zeros)
Ya phir: p(x) = k[x² - (α + β)x + αβ] jahan k ≠ 0
💡 Shortcut: x² - (Sum)x + (Product) = 0
If α, β, and γ are the zeros of cubic polynomial ax³ + bx² + cx + d (where a ≠ 0), then:
α + β + γ = -b/a
αβ + βγ + γα = c/a
αβγ = -d/a
💡 Pattern: Alternating signs! Sum = -b/a, Pair sum = c/a, Product = -d/a
Cubic: All Relationships:

α + β + γ = -b/a
αβ + βγ + γα = c/a
αβγ = -d/a
Where α, β, γ are zeros of ax³ + bx² + cx + d = 0

Example: For x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6 = 0
a=1, b=-6, c=11, d=-6
α+β+γ = 6, αβ+βγ+γα = 11, αβγ = 6
Zeros: 1, 2, 3 ✓

examples.problem: Find the sum and product of zeros of 2x² - 8x + 6.
Find a quadratic polynomial whose zeros are 3 and -2.
Find a cubic polynomial whose zeros are 1, 2, and 3.

questions.question: If α, β are zeros of 2x² - 8x + 6, then α + β = ?
A quadratic with zeros 3 and -2 is:
questions.explanation:
Sum = 3 + (-2) = 1, Product = 3 × (-2) = -6
Polynomial = x² - (1)x + (-6) = x² - x - 6

questions.question: If α, β, γ are zeros of x³ - 6x² + 11x - 6, then αβγ = ?
questions.explanation: For cubic ax³ + bx² + cx + d: αβγ = -d/a = -(-6)/1 = 6

questions.question: For quadratic ax² + bx + c, the product of zeros is -c/a.
questions.explanation: Product of zeros = c/a (NOT -c/a). Sirf sum mein negative sign hota hai: α + β = -b/a

questions.question: If sum of zeros = 5 and product = 6, the polynomial is:
questions.explanation:
p(x) = x² - (Sum)x + Product = x² - 5x + 6
Verify: x² - 5x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3), zeros: 2 and 3 ✓

notes: Quadratic ax² + bx + c: Sum = -b/a, Product = c/a

Cubic ax³ + bx² + cx + d:
  Sum = -b/a, Pair Sum = c/a, Product = -d/a
Cubic from zeros: x³ - (Sum)x² + (Pair Sum)x - Product
These relationships save time in exams!
summary: Key Points to Remember. Quadratic ax² + bx + c: Sum = -b/a, Product = c/a Quadratic from zeros: x² - (Sum)x + Product
